'''Creeper vines''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Vine/Legends|vine]] that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Datar/Legends|Datar]]<ref name="Ghostling">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''</ref> and [[Muzara]].<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> It was noted for its large, horn-shaped leaves and soft white [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="Ghostling" />
